summary: ChatGPT-style generative UI for Open WebUI: photo galleries, live maps with real routes, multi-day trips, budgets, calculators, live weather & stocks, link previews, and one-click Word/Excel/PowerPoint exports via ArtCraft. One file, no API keys.

Một tệp, không có khóa API.
